case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Monika Zellner,

Thank you for your offer of 19890 pcs per year at €32.20 per unit, with a 12-month contract term and a lead time of 54 days. We also appreciate our reliable cooperation.

Our bottom-up estimate of the full cost is EUR 24.31 per unit before margin (cost:340010). On that basis, we propose EUR 24.72 per unit, a 36-month contract, 23,400 units per year, a lead time of 42 days. The longer term would give you planning security while providing the volume and lead time we seek for our pump production.

We would welcome your thoughts on these terms and hope to find an arrangement that works for both sides.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, your offer is far below any calculation we can make. We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. 

Our Angebot is a price of €33.70 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, Lieferzeit 42 days, and a contract term of 36 months. A shorter Lieferzeit means overtime; that is priced in. The contract term is reflected in the price. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
